messages:
Lyla (AE): Quick follow-up Mark: can you confirm POC asks so we scope? I captured: Okta SAML, SCIM bulk+delta, group->role mapping, delegated admin tiers, audit export to EU S3. Anything missing?

Mark (Prospect): That's it. 95k users, nested groups, persistent NameID. Need audit retention 12 months and SSE-KMS on exported logs.

Diego (SE): We can do CSV bulk then SCIM delta. Will request temporary SCIM rate bump. For nested groups we'll expand client-side. We'll produce a runbook.

Sana (Security): Requirements: SCIM over mTLS, SAML attributes include groups claim, configurable SSO timeout, audit entries with user/email/action/timestamp/IP. We'll need to validate cert rotation.

Celia (Legal): If exporting logs to customer's S3 with their KMS, we'll need DPA addendum and key policy review. Delegated admin scopes must be enumerated.

Lyla (AE): Action items: Mark DM Okta org + sample CSV. Diego open OPS ticket for rate bump. Sana and Celia will send checklists. Proposed POC timeline: 10 business days.

Mark (Prospect): Sending DM now. One question: can Redwood soft-delete users during cutover?

Diego (SE): Yes, we support tombstones and timestamp-based conflict resolution. We'll document in the runbook.

Lyla (AE): I'll compile the POC checklist and post here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
